the build is a Vite production bundle: index.html -> assets/index-DF2rMRzV.js (React + React-Aria UI vendors, app music/track/ship tables, bundled three.js WebGPU+TSL, app UI) -> game-D43Oxqny.js (race sim), player-D3Mk6s3d.js (intro/garage), renderer-setup-PQ27DzE4.js + award-scene-DZbn-o_G.js (scenery), HDRLoader-Bse-uZFj.js (vendored three.js HDR loaders), audio-preparation.worker-CEAJS9BC.js (procedural audio worker), client-BtP_tmtQ.js (Wavedash SDK client shim)

encoding: the build host serves the text assets (index.html, JS/CSS chunks, embed.css) brotli-compressed (content-encoding: br). The capture stores the content-decoded bytes exactly as a browser receives them, so a naive static server serves the mirror correctly as identity; derive/audit inflate in memory only (never write re-encoded variants)

closure method: runtime network log of a full browser session (page load, main menu, intro/garage asset set, a complete 3-lap race and the finish screen — docs/network-log-2026-10-13.jsonl) + the game's embedded tables (five-circuit table, scenery->kit map, music library table, ship table, lunar/award textures in the intro set) — union probed to fixpoint; nothing referenced is missing. The content-hashed assets/ chunks are discovered at capture time by following the import graph from index.html (tools/capture.mjs), so a build refresh needs no hard-coded chunk names

payload size: captured closure 173009746 bytes vs upstream buildSizeBytes 192507792 — the delta is the platform shell files (embed/embed.js/embed.css/sw-embed.js) plus upload-side build content that no runtime request reaches (the game's own JS references no additional asset: the asset universe is unchanged from build 95; every payload byte is identical)
capture layout: repo root == the build-host root; every path is served at the same relative URL the game requests, so a static server reproduces the game's requests 1:1
network logs: docs/network-log-2026-10-13.jsonl (browser session; runtime-generated blob: audio worklet URLs elided)
